title: Bar Salts Cherry Raspberry Apple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape Bar Salts Cherry Raspberry Apple combines the bold sweetness of Cherry, the tangy sharpness of Raspberry, and the crisp, fresh flavour of Apple to create a layered and vibrant vaping experience. With a tart edge on the exhale, this fruity blend is ideal for vapers who enjoy complex and refreshing flavour combinations. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver the perfect balance of flavour and vapour production, making them an excellent choice for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as vape starter kits , pod kits and reusable vapes . The nicotine salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction, mirroring the intense and concentrated flavours found in disposable vapes. As a sustainable alternative to disposable vape bars, Bar Salts e-liquids come in a 10ml format, offering a longer-lasting, eco-friendly vaping option. Available in 0mg, 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cherry Raspberry Apple is a versatile and flavourful choice for adult smokers and vapers.
